title: Figure 7: ISFET needle-type pH sensor for monitoring tissue physiologic status
description: Photograph of a rocket-shaped silicon needle sensor chip with gold contact traces on a blue textured background. Beside it are line schematics labeled a) "MOSFET" and b) "ISFET" with a numbered legend (1: reference, 2: gate oxide, 3: insulating resin, 4: channel, S: source, D: drain, B: bulk) and a "solution" over the ISFET gate. The caption reads "Figure 7. An ISFET (Ion Sensitive Field Effect Transistor) Needle-Type pH Sensor for Monitoring Tissue Physiologic Status."
